name: vben-control-dashboard
description: Personal remote control panel for vben projects

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n agent,frontend -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w agent" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w agent
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w agent
